---
title: Curriculum vitæ
engine: knitr
freeze: false

resources:
  - "pages/*.png"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# The CV PDF is published from the rrmrr-vita repository. At render time this
# downloads it, reads its "last modified" date, and turns each page into an
# image (needs Poppler's `pdftoppm`; otherwise the page embeds the PDF).
library(httr)
cv_url <- "https://www.rrmaximiliano.com/rrmrr-vita/rrmrr-vita.pdf"
pdf_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".pdf")
res <- GET(cv_url, write_disk(pdf_file, overwrite = TRUE))
pdf_date <- headers(res)[["last-modified"]]
last_updated <- format(
  as.POSIXct(pdf_date, format = "%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S", tz = "GMT"),
  "%B %d, %Y"
)

pages <- character(0)
pdftoppm <- Sys.which("pdftoppm")
if (!nzchar(pdftoppm) && file.exists("/opt/homebrew/bin/pdftoppm")) pdftoppm <- "/opt/homebrew/bin/pdftoppm"
if (nzchar(pdftoppm)) {
  dir.create("pages", showWarnings = FALSE)
  unlink(Sys.glob("pages/cv-*.png"))
  system2(pdftoppm, c("-png", "-r", "144", shQuote(pdf_file), "pages/cv"))
  pages <- sort(Sys.glob("pages/cv-*.png"))
}

png_size <- function(f) {
  b <- readBin(f, "raw", 24)
  to_int <- function(x) sum(as.integer(x) * 256^(3:0))
  c(to_int(b[17:20]), to_int(b[21:24]))
}
```

```{=html}
<div class="cv-bar">
  <span class="cv-updated">Last updated `r last_updated`</span>
  <span class="cv-actions">
    <a href="`r cv_url`" download>Download PDF ↓</a><span class="sep"> | </span><a href="`r cv_url`" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open in a new tab ↗</a>
  </span>
</div>
```

```{r pages, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
cat("```{=html}\n")
if (length(pages)) {
  cat('<div class="cv-pages">\n')
  for (i in seq_along(pages)) {
    d <- png_size(pages[i])
    cat(sprintf(
      '<a class="cv-page" href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="%s" alt="CV, page %d of %d" width="%d" height="%d" loading="%s"></a>\n',
      cv_url, pages[i], i, length(pages), d[1], d[2], if (i == 1) "eager" else "lazy"
    ))
  }
  cat("</div>\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf('<div class="cv-frame"><iframe src="%s#toolbar=0&amp;navpanes=0&amp;view=FitH" title="Curriculum vitæ (PDF)" loading="lazy"></iframe></div>\n', cv_url))
}
cat("```\n")
```
